content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a streamlined process that ensures creators can sell their digital products directly to customers without relying on traditional payment platforms. In countries with restricted access to services like Stripe or PayPal, this infrastructure becomes crucial. By integrating tools such as NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can avoid steep fees—unlike Gumroad's 10% charge—retaining more revenue for their efforts. This model empowers creators, ensuring full data ownership and control over their products, contributing to a sustainable digital economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for automated ebook delivery involves several components that work together seamlessly. At its core, creators can host their storefront using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend logic is powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which facilitates order management and product delivery automation. With NOWPayments, crypto payments are processed in real-time, converting currencies at the time of transaction. This architecture eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, providing sovereignty and ensuring creators retain ownership of their digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators across regions where conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Whether you're selling ebooks, templates, or courses, this infrastructure serves anyone looking to monetize their digital products without incurring high transaction fees. By leveraging this architecture, creators can focus on their craft instead of navigating payment barriers, allowing them to reach a global audience while maintaining profitability.
Keep 99.5% of your sales with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this automated delivery system include GitHub or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. By utilizing free tools for hosting and order management, creators can establish a robust digital store with minimal upfront costs. NOWPayments simplifies the payment process, accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies with a mere 0.5% fee, which is significantly lower than traditional platforms. This combination creates an efficient and economically sustainable solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your automated ebook delivery system, follow these steps: First, set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, ensuring you understand the integration steps. Finally, upload your digital products and test the entire system to confirm seamless automation from purchase to delivery. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your ebook delivery process for seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a hosting account with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Implement backend logic through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Upload your digital products to your chosen storage solution, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the transaction process to ensure automated delivery works seamlessly. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for detailed guidance and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I create an online store for my ebooks?

To create an online store for your ebooks, use GitHub Pages for hosting, and implement Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments, allowing seamless transactions and automated delivery of your products.
What are the costs associated with selling digital downloads?

Selling digital downloads with this architecture involves minimal costs. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is free, and NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee per transaction compared to higher fees from platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell other digital products besides ebooks?

Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and can support a range of digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, beats, and software. The same automated delivery and payment processing capabilities apply.
Is there any support available after deployment?
Yes, when you purchase the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you'll receive 30 days of support to help you navigate any challenges or questions that arise during the deployment process.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin and Ethereum. This flexibility allows you to cater to a diverse customer base.
Retain full ownership and control over your digital products.
